evidence.citation: Artifact: "Stop and ask the user to define a real per-case bar: the intended outcome and specific failure smells. 'Make it good' is too vague, and the exact template should not be used as a proxy unless the user confirms this is a conformance-style skill."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact requires clarification of the evaluation bar before any run is spent. Under the supplied bar, establishing the intended outcome and acceptable evaluation basis is necessary validity/provenance work, not materially unnecessary execution work.
